verdict.rationale: An employer tax-filing portal like EAMS/eServices could plausibly offer scheduled or recurring filings or payments, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only describes one-off manual actions: filing quarterly reports online or by mail, amending reports, and setting up accounts. Nothing documents scheduling recurring jobs or workflows, and probes found no API, OpenAPI spec or machine-readable docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
